mapper.select: select user_no from tb_user where user_id = #{user_id} and user_pw = SHA2(#{user_pw}, 256) and user_role = '99'

select m.master_no , m.title , date_format(m.reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as reg_date , count(q.question_no) as question_count from tb_question_master m left join tb_question q on q.master_no = m.master_no and q.use_yn = 'Y' where m.use_yn = 'Y' group by m.master_no, m.title, m.reg_date order by m.reg_date desc
select question_no , master_no , seq , content , answer from tb_question where master_no = #{master_no} and use_yn = 'Y' order by seq

select i.item_no , i.question_no , i.content from tb_question_item i inner join tb_question q on q.question_no = i.question_no where q.master_no = #{master_no} and q.use_yn = 'Y' and i.use_yn = 'Y' order by i.question_no, i.item_no
mapper.insert: insert into tb_question_master (title, use_yn, reg_date, upd_date) values (#{title}, 'Y', now(), now())
mapper.update: update tb_question_master set use_yn = 'N' , upd_date = now() where master_no = #{master_no} and use_yn = 'Y'
update tb_answer set use_yn = 'N' where question_no in ( select question_no from tb_question where master_no = #{master_no} )
update tb_question_item i inner join tb_question q on q.question_no = i.question_no set i.use_yn = 'N' where q.master_no = #{master_no} and q.use_yn = 'Y' and i.use_yn = 'Y'
update tb_question set use_yn = 'N' , upd_date = now() where master_no = #{master_no} and use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: insert into tb_question (master_no, seq, content, use_yn, answer, reg_user, reg_date, upd_user, upd_date) values (#{master_no}, #{seq}, #{content}, 'Y', #{answer}, #{reg_user}, now(), #{reg_user}, now())
insert into tb_question_item (question_no, content, use_yn, reg_user) values (#{question_no}, #{content}, 'Y', #{reg_user})
mapper.update: update tb_answer set use_yn = 'N' where question_no = #{question_no} and use_yn = 'Y'
update tb_question_item set use_yn = 'N' where question_no = #{question_no} and use_yn = 'Y'
